title: E2E.Test.Nested.Direct.7z.AES.All.Wrong.2026.1080p-TESTGRP
description: A stored RAR5 holding a 7z whose data is AES-encrypted under clear headers. The job's one candidate is the wrong key: the posted set must still finalize direct and stream the child, and the job must fail on the child because no candidate decrypts it.
